issue.title: Pull an emptied project's ^prj in as a successor link, on the ^prj line model
issue.description: When a close gesture completes the last remaining task of a project note, its ^prj task is linked right after the closed task's link, becomes Next, and loses its hide tag in the same write. This works in bob capture (! and =x) and in Obsidian (Ctrl+Enter, Alt+]). "Empty" is exactly bob projects sync's surface predicate, so sync never re-hides a pulled-in ^prj. docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10/§12.11 become true (resolving bob-cli-6x). bob-cli just check fails only the bob-cli-6m tests, and bob-plugins npm test fails only the known bob-cli-6v, bob-cli-6w and bob-cli-3w cases. The new bob and plugins are installed on this host and, when reachable, on the MacBook.
